quandoUsar: Action bars over a board or document, like Undo, Redo, Present, and Share, with shortcut hints in the tooltip.
Floating bars over a selection or over the content (`variant="floating"`), with icons only and the name in a tooltip.
quandoEvitar: Use `button-group` when the actions should form a single surface with dividers or need an attached menu.
Use `toggle-group` when the buttons are options that turn on and off together, like bold and italic.
Use `overflow-actions` when the bar needs to fit varying widths: this tray does not collapse or wrap.

teclado.acao: Enters and leaves the bar in a single stop; focus returns to the last focused action.
Move focus between enabled actions and wrap around at the ends; in the `vertical` orientation, use `↓` and `↑`.
Go to the first and last enabled action.
Run the focused action; the highlight darkens while the key is held down.

acessibilidade: The tray is `role="toolbar"` with `aria-orientation` and a roving tabindex; each button has an `aria-label` equal to `label`, and `pressed` becomes `aria-pressed` for mode actions, like Present.
Icon-only items or items with `shortcut` get a tooltip with the name and shortcut, on mouse hover or keyboard focus; `shortcut` is only a hint, the component does not register the key.
`disabled` items get `aria-disabled` and are skipped by the arrows, by `Home`, and by `End`.
movimento: A single highlight moves and resizes to the button under the pointer or in focus, on a spring with no overshoot; coming from nothing, it appears in place growing from 0.94, and fades when the pointer leaves.
On press, the highlight darkens and shrinks to 0.965 in place; a new label, like Share → Copied, rises from a slight blur without changing the width if it is in `reserveLabels`.
With “reduce motion”, the highlight jumps to the button with no scale and colors change almost instantly.
responsivo: The tray always keeps its natural size: it does not wrap or clip buttons, so on a narrow screen it overflows; use `iconOnly` or fewer items.
In the `vertical` orientation, tooltips open to the right by default (`tooltipSide`), so they do not cover the neighboring button.
notasIA: Depends on `tooltip`, installed alongside; each action needs `id` and `label`, and an item `{ type: "separator" }` draws a divider.
For mode actions, pass `pressed` controlled by the parent and toggle it in `onSelect`; `onAction(id)` runs after the item's `onSelect`, good for logging usage.
If a label changes after the click, list all the texts in `reserveLabels`; `iconOnly` on the group applies to all items, and each item's `iconOnly` takes priority.
